_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live since 2022-11-30, but the sell-side read for ACN was share gain (J.P.Morgan, 2023-02-10) and the stock trades at 25.0x FY23E — near its own median, not an AI discount. Re-file under AI_EXPOSED only when the multiple starts discounting the legacy-services deflation J.P.Morgan describes, or it shows up in managed-services growth.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.07x; +39% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.01; conservative 2yr +1%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (the decade's worst year, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +9.8%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.8%/yr (decade CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +16.5%/yr (best 2-yr run of the decade); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2023-02-10) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 1.07x (29.9% downside to Bear $199 / +27.8% upside to Bull $363) | Adj composite 3.06 vs market 3.07: gap -0.01 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +39% above the EPP floor $204 (18x FY23E $11.36) | Conservative 2-yr case: +0.8% total (+0.4%/yr) | At 25.0x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $376 sits above the BULL case; consulting +10% LC in Q1, Q2 guided +6-10% LC; GenAI is a live theme, read by the sell side as share gain for consultancies, not a threat.
